product_principle: Surface meaningful changes in insider behavior, not raw filing volume.

primary_signals.label: Out of character
primary_signals.description: Compares the current purchase with that insider's prior purchase sizes.

primary_signals.label: Quiet buyer returns
primary_signals.description: Measures whether an insider bought after an unusually long absence.

primary_signals.label: Wolf pack
primary_signals.description: Identifies independent operating insiders buying the same company.

primary_signals.label: Growing position
primary_signals.description: Measures how much the purchase increased reported ownership.

primary_signals.label: Conviction accelerating
primary_signals.description: Measures whether purchase size or frequency is increasing across campaigns.

score_distinction.behavior_change: How different the current behavior is from the insider's own history.
score_distinction.conviction: How strong and interpretable the complete evidence is after context and penalties.

causality: Historical event scores use only information available before each event. Forward returns are evaluation-only and are never live score inputs.
limitations: A purchase can be sincere and still precede poor investment performance.
First-ever purchases have high novelty but limited personal history.
Indirect ownership and filing footnotes can materially change interpretation.
yfinance is an unofficial market-data source.
